metadata.title: Hmarcha rawt | Mizo Grilled Chili Chutney
metadata.description:
Hmarcha rawt is a Mizo style hot flavorful chutney made of fire grilled chilies . 

The chutney is hot and tangy and takes just under 15 minutes to make. The Mizo people of Mizoram have it as a staple side to the main dish.
